dx_hgbl_double_hit.quote: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements (HGBL-DH; formerly 'double-hit' lymphoma), GCB immunophenotype

mn_dx_dlbcl_nos.quote: The initial diagnosis of DLBCL, NOS was amended after FISH showed an IGH::MYC t(8;14) rearrangement in 78% of nuclei and an IGH::BCL2 t(14;18) rearrangement in 85%

dx_gcb_hans.quote: GCB phenotype by the Hans algorithm: CD20+, PAX5+, CD10+, BCL6+, MUM1- (<10%)

tx_plan_outdated.quote: Do not give the planned R-CHOP. Change to DA-EPOCH-R (dose-adjusted etoposide, prednisone, vincristine, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin plus rituximab) for 6 cycles, starting now

stage_ii_bulky.quote: Ann Arbor stage IIA, bulky: right cervical levels II-IV and anterior mediastinal nodal disease, all above the diaphragm, with a 12.0 cm mediastinal mass (bulky, >10 cm)

mn_stage_iii_iv.quote: Ann Arbor stage IIA, bulky: right cervical levels II-IV and anterior mediastinal nodal disease, all above the diaphragm

bio_double_expressor_secondary.quote: BCL2+ in 90% of tumor cells, MYC+ in 80%, Ki-67 approximately 95%... The bulky mediastinal mass, high LDH, Ki-67 ~95%, and MYC/BCL2 co-expression further increase risk.

prog_ipi1_biology_dominates.quote: IPI 1 (low) and CNS-IPI 1 (low), but both scores understate the risk conferred by double-hit biology.

tx_intensive_curative.quote: Do not give the planned R-CHOP. Change to DA-EPOCH-R (dose-adjusted etoposide, prednisone, vincristine, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin plus rituximab) for 6 cycles, starting now

mn_rchop_preferred.quote: Do not give the planned R-CHOP.

mn_non_curative.quote: The goal is curative-intent treatment, and the patient has explicitly asked for the regimen with the best chance of cure

tx_isrt_consolidation.quote: I would not plan consolidative radiation or routine first-remission autologous transplant; reserve radiation for a residual PET-positive bulky mass

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: I would not routinely obtain brain MRI, testicular ultrasound, or pulmonary function tests because the history, examination, and PET/CT are negative in those domains.

cns_prophylaxis.quote: give intrathecal methotrexate 12 mg for 4 doses starting with cycle 1, because DA-EPOCH-R does not include high-dose systemic methotrexate.

mn_cns_dismissed.quote: double-hit histology is an independent high-risk feature, and reported CNS relapse rates in HGBL-DH are higher

resp_pet_lugano.quote: Interim PET/CT after 2 cycles of DA-EPOCH-R (Lugano 2014 criteria, Deauville 5-point scale) to identify early chemorefractory disease, then end-of-treatment PET/CT about 6-8 weeks after cycle 6.

sup_gcsf.quote: Give G-CSF with DA-EPOCH-R per the dose-adjustment schedule

sup_tls.quote: Start intravenous hydration and allopurinol 300 mg daily now (adjusted for renal function), check G6PD, and monitor urate, potassium, phosphate, calcium, creatinine, and LDH 6-8 hours after the first dose and then daily

sup_central_access_infusion.quote: DA-EPOCH-R is given as a 96-hour continuous infusion with rituximab on day 1, cyclophosphamide on day 5, and G-CSF support

sup_svc_airway.quote: monitor for stridor, dyspnea, or worsening facial swelling, and treat urgent airway or SVC compromise with radiation or a vascular stent

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: No hepatitis B antiviral prophylaxis is needed because HBsAg and anti-HBc are negative and anti-HBs is positive, but monitor liver tests.

work_echo_reviewed.quote: Monitor cardiac function (baseline LVEF 60%; cumulative doxorubicin will be about 240 mg/m2)

fit_intensive.quote: Fit for intensive therapy: 54 years old, ECOG 1, working, no organ dysfunction, LVEF 60%, eGFR 101 mL/min/1.73 m2, normal liver function, and no prior anthracycline or chest radiation.
